scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build -w templates/basic -w templates/topdown -w templates/isometric -w templates/sidescroller -w templates/pointclick -w templates/platformer -w templates/mossfell -w templates/squish
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run lint:packages && npm run test:scenarios
scripts.test:scenarios: npm test -w templates/basic -w templates/topdown -w templates/isometric -w templates/sidescroller -w templates/pointclick -w templates/platformer -w templates/mossfell -w templates/squish && npm run test:browser -w spryte
scripts.release: npm run check && changeset publish && node scripts/sync-plugin.mjs && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:ci: npm run build && changeset publish && git push origin --tags && node scripts/sync-plugin.mjs && git push origin main
scripts.compat: npm run build && npm install --prefix compat --no-audit --no-fund && node compat/run.mjs
